about.source: Wikimedia Commons, Ancient Chinese characters project; gaps filled from Academia Sinica 小學堂
about.rule: Wikimedia Commons first: only files under {{ACClicense}} without the Richard Sears parameter (public domain), or CC0 files traced from Academia Sinica 小學堂. A shown stage with no such file is filled from Academia Sinica 小學堂 directly (glyph images and attributes from its query interface are CC0 1.0, https://xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw/License/License). Files are never redrawn; a stage with neither is left out.
about.stages: oracle, bronze and seal are shown and self-hosted under /ancient (Commons: sanitised SVG; 小學堂: PNG); `other` lists Commons big seal, slip and silk files that pass the same filter (recorded, not downloaded).
about.radicals: Radicals whose kanji mostly belong to another Kangxi radical than the display char suggests (Unihan kRSUnicode), e.g. 月 nikuzuki -> 肉.
about.xiaoxue: Academia Sinica 小學堂 字形演變 (yanbian) query: https://xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw/yanbian
about.xiaoxueSelection: Per stage, the first glyph the 字形演變 result lists in that script: oracle = first 甲骨文 font glyph, bronze = first 金文 font glyph, seal = the 說文 small seal (北師大說文小篆 font, label 說文‧X部; else 說文篆文). The image is cropped to its ink, made transparent (alpha from luminance), scaled down to at most 256 px and saved as black-on-transparent PNG. Glyphs that look empty or broken (tiny, almost no ink, or over 12 KB: speckled rubbing scans) are dropped and the stage stays empty.
